title: epan: Remove introduced UTF-8 BOMs encoding in files
description:
AI generated script introduced UTF-8 BOMs encodings into files from 5729065a3edb3794974e5bb4365f3137bbcac1a7, remove them.

Also add check to checkAPIs.pl so it can't happen again.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
added this merge request to the [merge train](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_trains) at position 2
